scope: Offline observed-raster representation implementation and fixed-input verification; no physical selector or production integration.

spec.partition: maximal degree-two chains; all junction alternatives, cycles and isolates retained
spec.limits: Raster adjacency is not physical correspondence. No seed, rank, scalar, gap bridge, thinning, junction pairing or material selection.

preflight.hypothesis: Exact 8-neighbour edge fragments preserve local shape and all branch alternatives without a shared height seed. This does not certify a physical contour.
preflight.checks: Every observed pixel and every original adjacency retained, each graph link in exactly one fragment; crop/mask context preserved; existing inputs/source unchanged; no scalar or physical decision.
preflight.controls: Nine previously exposed public frames at native/height200 plus seven existing sample4 frames 420/450/480/1620/1635/1665/1680. 1635 remains unreviewed.
preflight.graph_coordinate_space: working pixel centers with origin(0,0); source=source_crop_origin+(working+.5)*source_per_pixel-.5. Original source coordinates are never inferred from a scaled index alone.
preflight.visibility: public full rectangle AND not unchanged preprocessing glare; sample4 captured effective AND not captured glare.
preflight.stop_rule: No new thresholds, thinning, gap joining, branch selection or scale/window changes after observation. Missing raw edges and topology ambiguity remain unavailable for physical selection.
preflight.display: All-case sheets use frozen whole crops. Water inclined detail uses existing source review context X740:1160/Y300:730, display only; colors identify fragments, white=degree>2 junction, magenta=missing local context.

readout.verification: Original-pixel reconstruction; Signed 16-bit 3x3 convolution and independent shifted-array sum count every adjacency; unique graph links are true pixel neighbours; fragment link multiset equals graph; degree-two interiors; crop/visibility flags independently reconstructed.

import cv2

OUT=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-edge-fragments-20261009-002'

sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(name,obj): (OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')

sources={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in sorted((ROOT/'src').rglob('*.py'))}
models={str(p):sha(ROOT/p) for p in map(Path,[
 'tests/diagnostics/s11_contour_contact_probe.py','tests/unit/test_s11_edge_fragments.py',

                  'source_identity':identity,'scale':r['scale'],'crop_xyxy':r['crop_xyxy'],
                  'source_per_pixel_xy':r['source_per_working_pixel_xy'],
                  'shape':r['working_shape'],'arrays_path':r['arrays_path'],
                  'input_mode':'recompute_unchanged_public_preprocessing'})
trace_name=next(k for k in legacy['preflight']['inputs'] if k.endswith('.jsonl'))
inputs[trace_name]=legacy['preflight']['inputs'][trace_name]
trace_root=(ROOT/trace_name).parent
wanted=set(legacy['preflight']['frames'])
for line in (ROOT/trace_name).open():
    row=json.loads(line)
    if row['frame_index'] not in wanted: continue
    witness=row['state']['oil_interface_witness']
    origin=witness['crop_origin'];w,h=witness['crop_size']
    paths={}
    for key in ('original_roi','canny','effective_mask','glare_mask'):
        p=trace_root/row['images'][key];name=str(p.relative_to(ROOT))

                  'input_mode':'captured_edges_and_visibility'})

for name,pin in {**inputs,**sources,**models}.items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==pin,name
preflight={'schema':'s11-observed-edge-fragments-preflight-v1',
 'base_head':'3b73f269d015c5826c38325e2feffc23778f7eb7','spec':FRAGMENT_SPEC,
 'inputs':inputs,'production_sources':sources,'diagnostic_sources':models,'cases':cases,
 'settings':public['preflight']['settings'],'runner_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),
 'hypothesis':'Exact 8-neighbour edge fragments preserve local shape and all branch alternatives without a shared height seed. This does not certify a physical contour.',
 'checks':'Every observed pixel and every original adjacency retained, each graph link in exactly one fragment; crop/mask context preserved; existing inputs/source unchanged; no scalar or physical decision.',
 'controls':'Nine previously exposed public frames at native/height200 plus seven existing sample4 frames 420/450/480/1620/1635/1665/1680. 1635 remains unreviewed.',

 'visibility':'public full rectangle AND not unchanged preprocessing glare; sample4 captured effective AND not captured glare.',
 'stop_rule':'No new thresholds, thinning, gap joining, branch selection or scale/window changes after observation. Missing raw edges and topology ambiguity remain unavailable for physical selection.',
 'partition':'development','video_decode':False,'full_detector_run':False,'production_change':False,
 'display':'All-case sheets use frozen whole crops. Water inclined detail uses existing source review context X740:1160/Y300:730, display only; colors identify fragments, white=degree>2 junction, magenta=missing local context.'}
write('preflight.json',preflight);(OUT/'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())

def verify(graph,edges,visible):
    xy=graph['vertices_xy'];x=xy[:,0];y=xy[:,1];active=edges&visible;n=len(xy)
    rebuilt=np.zeros_like(active);rebuilt[y,x]=True
    assert np.array_equal(rebuilt,active)
    links=graph['links'];a=xy[links[:,0]];b=xy[links[:,1]]
    assert np.all(np.max(np.abs(a-b),axis=1)==1)
    keys=links[:,0].astype(np.int64)*max(n,1)+links[:,1]
    assert len(np.unique(keys))==len(keys) and np.all(links[:,0]<links[:,1])
    kernel=np.ones((3,3),np.uint8);kernel[1,1]=0
    counts=cv2.filter2D(active.astype(np.uint8),cv2.CV_16S,kernel,borderType=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
    padded=np.pad(active.astype(np.int16),1);shifted=np.zeros(active.shape,np.int16)
    for dy in range(3):
        for dx in range(3):
            if (dy,dx)!=(1,1): shifted+=padded[dy:dy+active.shape[0],dx:dx+active.shape[1]]
    assert np.array_equal(counts,shifted)
    assert int(counts[active].sum())==2*len(links)
    assert np.array_equal(counts[y,x],graph['degree'])
    membership=np.zeros(n,bool);traced=np.empty(len(links),np.int64);cursor=0
    for chain,kind in zip(graph['fragments'],graph['fragment_kinds'],strict=True):
        c=np.asarray(chain,np.int64);membership[c]=True
        if len(c)==1:assert kind=='isolated' and graph['degree'][c[0]]==0
        else:
            assert np.all(graph['degree'][c[1:-1]]==2)
            if kind=='cycle':assert c[0]==c[-1] and graph['degree'][c[0]]==2
            else:assert graph['degree'][c[0]]!=2 and graph['degree'][c[-1]]!=2
            k=np.minimum(c[:-1],c[1:])*max(n,1)+np.maximum(c[:-1],c[1:])
            traced[cursor:cursor+len(k)]=k;cursor+=len(k)
    assert cursor==len(links) and membership.all()
    assert np.array_equal(np.sort(traced),np.sort(keys))
    missing=cv2.filter2D((~visible).astype(np.uint8),cv2.CV_16S,np.ones((3,3),np.uint8),borderType=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)>0
    assert np.array_equal(missing[y,x],graph['unavailable_adjacent'])
    h,w=edges.shape
    assert np.array_equal((x==0)|(y==0)|(x==w-1)|(y==h-1),graph['crop_adjacent'])

results=[];views={}
for case in cases:
    if case['input_mode']=='recompute_unchanged_public_preprocessing':
        with np.load(ROOT/case['arrays_path'],allow_pickle=False) as arrays:
            crop=arrays['crop'].copy();saved_glare=arrays['glare'].copy()
        mask=np.full(crop.shape[:2],255,np.uint8)
        prep=preprocess(crop,mask,DetectorSettings(**preflight['settings']))
        assert np.array_equal(prep.glare_mask,saved_glare)
        edge=prep.canny>0;visible=~(prep.glare_mask>0)
    else:
        paths=case['images']
        crop=cv2.imread(str(ROOT/paths['original_roi']),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        edge=cv2.imread(str(ROOT/paths['canny']),cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)>0
        effective=cv2.imread(str(ROOT/paths['effective_mask']),cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)>0
        glare=cv2.imread(str(ROOT/paths['glare_mask']),cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)>0
        visible=effective&~glare
    assert list(edge.shape)==case['shape'] and crop.shape[:2]==edge.shape
    before=[hashlib.sha256(v.tobytes()).hexdigest() for v in (crop,edge,visible)]
    start=time.perf_counter();g=measure_edge_fragments(edge,visible);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
    verify(g,edge,visible)
    assert before==[hashlib.sha256(v.tobytes()).hexdigest() for v in (crop,edge,visible)]
    sizes=np.asarray([len(f) for f in g['fragments']],np.int64)
    fragment_offsets=np.concatenate(([0],np.cumsum(sizes)))
    ids=np.asarray([v for chain in g['fragments'] for v in chain],np.int32)
    kinds={'chain':0,'cycle':1,'isolated':2,'junction_return':3}
    path=OUT/(case['case_id']+'.npz')
    np.savez_compressed(path,edges=edge,visible=visible,vertices_xy=g['vertices_xy'],links=g['links'],
                        degree=g['degree'],crop_adjacent=g['crop_adjacent'],unavailable_adjacent=g['unavailable_adjacent'],
                        fragment_offsets=fragment_offsets,fragment_vertices=ids,
                        fragment_kinds=np.asarray([kinds[k] for k in g['fragment_kinds']],np.uint8))
    spans=[int(np.ptp(g['vertices_xy'][f,1])) for f in g['fragments']]
    row={'case_id':case['case_id'],'status':g['status'],'observed_vertices':len(g['vertices_xy']),
         'links':len(g['links']),'fragments':len(sizes),'fragment_kinds':dict(collections.Counter(g['fragment_kinds'])),
         'degree_histogram':np.bincount(g['degree'],minlength=9).tolist(),
         'crop_adjacent_vertices':int(g['crop_adjacent'].sum()),'unavailable_adjacent_vertices':int(g['unavailable_adjacent'].sum()),
         'largest_fragment_vertex_count':int(sizes.max()) if sizes.size else 0,
         'largest_fragment_y_span':max(spans,default=0),
         'graph_seconds':elapsed,'pixel_link_fragment_conservation_verified':True,
         'preprocessing_glare_equal':True if case['input_mode'].startswith('recompute') else None,
         'arrays_path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),'arrays_sha256':sha(path),
         'physical_identity':g['physical_identity'],'decision':g['decision'],'selected_front':g['selected_front']}
    results.append(row)
    rgb=cv2.cvtColor(crop,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB);overlay=(rgb*.45).astype(np.uint8)
    xy=g['vertices_xy']
    palette=(plt.get_cmap('hsv')(np.arange(37)/37)[:,:3]*255).astype(np.uint8)
    for i,f in enumerate(g['fragments']):
        points=xy[f];overlay[points[:,1],points[:,0]]=palette[(i*13)%37]
    junction=xy[g['degree']>2];overlay[junction[:,1],junction[:,0]]=[255,255,255]
    censored=xy[g['crop_adjacent']|g['unavailable_adjacent']];overlay[censored[:,1],censored[:,0]]=[255,0,255]
    views[case['case_id']]=(rgb,overlay)
    print(case['case_id'],row['observed_vertices'],'pixels',row['fragments'],'fragments',flush=True)

for group in ('sample5','sample6','sample7'):
    base=[c for c in cases if c['group']==f'sample/{group}.mp4' and c['scale']=='native']
    fig,axs=plt.subplots(3,3,figsize=(13,13),layout='constrained')
    for row,c in enumerate(base):
        stem=c['case_id'].removesuffix('-native');imgs=[views[c['case_id']][0],views[c['case_id']][1],views[stem+'-height_200'][1]]

            ax.set_title(stem+' / '+title,fontsize=9);ax.set_xlabel('source X');ax.set_ylabel('source Y')
    fig.suptitle(f'{group}: lossless observed-edge fragments; colors are not physical labels\nWhite = raster junction; magenta = crop/mask context missing',fontsize=12)
    fig.savefig(OUT/f'{group}-fragments.png',dpi=125,bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig)
base=[c for c in cases if c['group']=='sample/sample4.mp4']
fig,axs=plt.subplots(len(base),2,figsize=(8,3*len(base)),layout='constrained')
for row,c in enumerate(base):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=c['crop_xyxy']
    for ax,img,title in zip(axs[row],views[c['case_id']],('saved original','observed fragments')):
        ax.imshow(img,extent=(x0-.5,x1-.5,y1-.5,y0-.5),interpolation='nearest')
        ax.set_title(c['case_id']+' / '+title);ax.set_xlabel('source X');ax.set_ylabel('source Y')
fig.suptitle('sample4: existing regional reviews only; f1635 remains unreviewed')
fig.savefig(OUT/'sample4-fragments.png',dpi=125,bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,5),layout='constrained')
for ax,img,title in zip(axs,[views['s5-inclined-native'][0],views['s5-inclined-native'][1],views['s5-inclined-height_200'][1]],['original','native fragments','height-200 fragments']):
    ax.imshow(img,extent=(739.5,1159.5,1079.5,249.5),interpolation='nearest')
    ax.set_xlim(740,1160);ax.set_ylim(730,300);ax.set_title(title);ax.set_xlabel('source X');ax.set_ylabel('source Y')
fig.suptitle('Inclined water surface: preserved edge pixels, not a selected contour\nWhite = raster junction; magenta = missing local context; colors = fragment IDs')
fig.savefig(OUT/'water-detail.png',dpi=130,bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig)
for name,pin in {**inputs,**sources,**models}.items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==pin,name
write('readout.json',{'schema':'s11-observed-edge-fragments-readout-v1','preflight_sha256':sha(OUT/'preflight.json'),
 'runtime':{'python':platform.python_version(),'numpy':np.__version__,'opencv':cv2.__version__},
 'results':results,'input_and_source_preserved':True,'all_graphs_verified':True,
 'fragment_kind_encoding':{'chain':0,'cycle':1,'isolated':2,'junction_return':3},
 'figures':{str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in sorted(OUT.glob('*.png'))},
 'verification':'Original-pixel reconstruction; Signed 16-bit 3x3 convolution and independent shifted-array sum count every adjacency; unique graph links are true pixel neighbours; fragment link multiset equals graph; degree-two interiors; crop/visibility flags independently reconstructed.',
 'selected_fronts':0,'formal_labels_changed':False,'production_changed':False})
print('COMPLETE',OUT,flush=True)
